translations.web: And thus the secrets of his heart are revealed. So he will fall down on his face and worship God, declaring that God is among you indeed.
translations.bsb: and the secrets of his heart will be made known. So he will fall facedown and worship God, proclaiming, “God is truly among you!”
translations.kjv: And thus are ➔ the secrets of his heart made manifest; and so falling down on his face he will worship God, and report that God is in you of a truth.
translations.asv: the secrets of his heart are made manifest; and so he will fall down on his face and worship God, declaring that God is among you indeed.
